name: Mission Accomplished!

description: Mission Accomplished!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, your successful re-engineering of the cauldrons is a tremendous victory for us!

Let all within my presence hear: for service to the Kingdom of Stormwind and to the Alliance above and beyond the call of duty - in the face of overwhelming odds and incredible danger, might I add - I give friend this, and I extend upon them our undying gratitude as a true hero of the Alliance. Cheers, I say!
